acceptanceCriteria: Changing a shared Outcome parameter default, enum, type, requiredness or description requires editing one executable definition, and CLI parsing, MCP schema, machine description and generated reference facts follow it.
Transport-only names and aliases are represented once as adapter bindings; MCP-only deliveryProgress is defined from the MCP executable schema rather than a duplicate discovery fact table.
CLI and MCP behavior, existing Outcome delivery semantics and generated three-language reference regions remain compatible.
The discovery projection remains deterministic and read-only: no repository observation, verification subprocess, network or clock access.
authority: User standing authorization for in-scope implementation and lifecycle decisions recorded in conversation.
goal: Replace manual transport and MCP-only outcome parameter fact tables with projections derived from executable definitions, while retaining only unavoidable transport adaptation and preserving CLI/MCP behavior.
intent: Eliminate the remaining duplicated runtime interface facts in the work-item outcome discovery pilot so one executable definition drives CLI parsing, MCP schema and generated reference facts.
